title: OLEA × Alpesa
subtitle: Premium olive-oil packaging in a cardboard tube
deck: Proving that a cardboard tube can carry a premium extra-virgin olive oil brand.
role: Structural design of the tube and closures, technical drawings and renders.
team: Leire Arias, Mikel Arnao, Manex Gonzalez, Maria Martinez

hero.caption: OLEA tube in an Andalusian olive grove.

sections.title: Context and brief
paragraphs: Alpesa makes cardboard tubes. The challenge was to show they can work in high-value segments. Premium extra-virgin olive oil grows around 12 % a year in the specialised European channel, yet most of its packaging does not live up to the product.

sections.title: Research
paragraphs: A benchmark of Castillo de Canena, Almazaras de la Subbética, Oro Bailén and Finca de la Torre found shared values: materiality over visual impact, origin as the main argument, typographic restraint and full coherence. None of them had explored the tube.

figures.caption: Inspiration: cortijo floors and olive-grove geometry.

sections.title: Concept
paragraphs: From territory to object: unvarnished kraft recalls the walls and floors of the cortijo, a classical serif recalls oil-mill labels and the olive grove seen from the air becomes pattern.

figures.caption: Experience: from the shop shelf to the table.
